changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwvaccinedoses AS SELECT vd.id, vd.vaccine_id, vd.dose_number, vd.from_age, vd.to_age, vd.from_age_unit, vd.to_age_unit, vd.is_booster, vd.is_active, vd.created_by, vd.created_date, vd.last_modified_by, vd.last_modified_date FROM public.vaccine_doses vd;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwvaccinedoses TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwvaccinedoses FROM report_user;
